asked.item: Should I shrink them to 1080 max on the long side?
What to do about the error

verdict.reason: The FAQ on this exact TikTok error says the limit is based on area and that 1080 × 1920 is within it. It also gives troubleshooting steps.

steps.text: You don't need to shrink them: the image limit is based on area, not a maximum side length of 1080 pixels, and a 1080 × 1920 portrait image is within the documented 1080p area limit.
Blotato converts non-JPEG images before submission, so don't reject a source solely because it is PNG.
Open the failed destination in Posts > Failed or its request in Logs, and keep the exact error and request ID.
Check the caption and TikTok options against the error.
If the cause is still unclear, send support the error and request ID rather than repeatedly publishing tests.
